cleared.check: Task 1 (a) and (b): nested write and fail probe (scripts/nested.py, fixed cases, no sampling). A contract placed by code override writes TSTORE or SSTORE values at depth 0, then at depths 1 to 4 in a chain of calls, and makes the frame at depth d = 1, 2 or 3 end by REVERT, INVALID, an endless loop under a 300,000 gas cap, or entry by STATICCALL, with a successful child write inside the failing frame. The parent reads the four slots back. 15 transient and 15 persistent cases per endpoint, each compared with tools/opdiff/pyevm.py on the same code and calldata (the gas case run there as INVALID, since pyevm has no gas).
cleared.result: Every answer equals the reference on every build that answered: Arc 37812c61 (rpc.mainnet.arc.io and QuickNode, 60 cases), 8e8edb7a (both dRPC hosts, 60), 602eed3b (PublicNode, 30), db2d22c1 (Blockdaemon, 30); Elysium nitro vlocal go1.25.12 (Kinetiq and Conduit, 60) and dRPC (30); HyperEVM 'hyperliquid evm Mainnet' (official and hypurrscan, 60), nanoreth b92ad36 (HyperLend and Stakely, 60), dRPC 27; MegaETH mega-reth v2.3.1-4499c42 (30), v2.2.1-7d0dbf3 (30), dRPC 28; BNB Chain dataseed v1.8.2 and 4e1c8247 (90), reth-bsc v0.1.4-hotfix-23b510f (30), 48 Club 9b93ce23 and 132104cd (30). The five dRPC requests that did not answer were HTTP 429 refusals, not answers. In every failed frame the slots return to the parent's words (0xAA00+i), writes of frames above the failing one are kept, and a static frame's TSTORE or SSTORE is refused. These are the semantics that Lock, NonzeroDeltaCount, CurrencyDelta and CurrencyReserves rely on.

cleared.check: Task 1 (c): the unlock probe of cycle 31 (cycles/031/theme-nitro-binary-storage-lift.work/scripts/live_nitro.py, run unchanged) on the deployed PoolManager with its real code and state: one unlock initializes a hookless pool of two code-less currencies, adds liquidity, swaps, lets a helper swap again and revert (variant settled), keep its debt (kept, unlock must revert with CurrencyNotSettled) or nest a further reverted swap (nested), reads every delta slot, NonzeroDeltaCount, slot0 and fee growth, and settles with ERC-6909 burns. Compared byte for byte with pyevm.py over storage read lazily from the same block.
cleared.result: All three variants equal the reference on 16 endpoints: Arc arc/v1 (two hosts), dRPC, PublicNode and Blockdaemon reth v2.2.0-508cbdf; Elysium Kinetiq and Conduit; HyperEVM official, hypurrscan and nanoreth b92ad36; MegaETH v2.3.1-4499c42 and v2.2.1-7d0dbf3; BNB Chain dataseed1, dataseed2, PublicNode reth-bsc and 48 Club 9b93ce23. The settled deltas were -30553010879137170 and -28557003898097267 on every endpoint. A reverted helper's swap left no delta and no count, and a kept debt made unlock revert, so PoolManager.sol:112 reads the count the specification gives. The unlock script brackets with web3_clientVersion only, so the Arc commit is known for it only through the bracketed runs on the same hosts minutes apart.

cleared.check: Task 1 (d): TokenRollbackProbe of cycle 16 placed at each deployed PoolManager address (real balances, no balance override), sending 1 unit from the PoolManager in frames that revert, hit INVALID, recurse until the stack or gas runs out, loop until out of gas, or are static, with the control last (scripts/tokprobe.py). Currencies: Arc USDC ERC-20 face 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000 and native value; Elysium HYPE native value; HyperEVM HYPE native value, USD₮0 0xB8CE59FC3717ada4C02eaDF9682A9e934F625ebb (HyperCore-linked) and WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555; MegaETH ETH native value and USDm 0xFAfDdbb3FC7688494971a79cc65DCa3EF82079E7; BNB Chain BNB and USDT 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955. Where no ERC-20 face exists, the balance slot uses a stub contract placed by override.
cleared.result: On all 39 runs on 17 endpoints no failed or static frame changed any of the four balance words (probe and recipient, token face and native), the control moved exactly one unit, and the static transfer was refused. On Arc the native transfer of 1 wei left the face at its value and the face transfer of 1 unit moved 10^12 wei of native balance, both only in the control frame. The settle path that reads these words is Currency.balanceOfSelf through PoolManager._settle, which therefore cannot read a balance a reverted frame moved.

cleared.check: Task 2: Arc pinned per build (scripts/arcpin.py). On each of six hosts, 10 rounds of arc_getVersion, face probe, arc_getVersion, native probe, arc_getVersion; a probe is attributed to a build only when the versions read just before and after it name the same commit. Transfer logs were read through eth_simulateV1 where served.
cleared.result: Every probe was pinned and every one rolled back: 37812c61 (v0.8.6-rc1) answered 40 runs on rpc.mainnet.arc.io and rpc.quicknode.mainnet.arc.io, 8e8edb7a (v0.8.6) 40 runs on arc.drpc.org and rpc.drpc.mainnet.arc.io, 602eed3b (v0.8.5) 20 runs on arc-rpc.publicnode.com, and db2d22c1 (v0.8.5, a fourth build not named before this cycle) 20 runs on rpc.blockdaemon.mainnet.arc.io. With the unpinned token, nested and script runs, each of the four builds answered every probe. Logs: on 8e8edb7a and 602eed3b eth_simulateV1 returned only the control's Transfer logs (for the face transfer one log from 0x3600... with value 1 and one from 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe with value 10^12; for the native transfer one log from 0xff...fe with value 1), so the five failed and static frames dropped theirs. 37812c61 refuses eth_simulateV1 and debug_traceCall (-32601), and Blockdaemon filters both (HTTP 403), so the log drop is unchecked on 37812c61 and db2d22c1. raw.githubusercontent.com/circlefin/arc-node returns the tree at 602eed3b and 404 at 37812c61, 8e8edb7a and db2d22c1.

cleared.check: Transient storage cleared between transactions, through eth_simulateV1 (scripts/txreset.py): in one simulated block a call writes TSTORE(5, 7) and SSTORE(5, 9) and a second call reads both, then a second simulated block reads both again. EIP-1153 requires the transient read to be 0 and the persistent read 9.
cleared.result: Both reads return 0 and 9 on Arc 8e8edb7a and 602eed3b, Elysium (two hosts), HyperEVM nanoreth b92ad36, MegaETH v2.2.1-7d0dbf3 and all four BNB Chain hosts. Lock, NonzeroDeltaCount and the delta slots therefore start each transaction at zero on those builds. Arc 37812c61, MegaETH v2.3.1-4499c42 and the official HyperEVM endpoint refuse eth_simulateV1, so this check did not run on them; cycle 16 found mined undone-then-completed unlocks on BNB Chain only of these five.

cleared.check: Task 3: pmdiff.py (250 scripts, seed 7_2026_11_24), pmdiff2.py (300 scripts, seed 11_2026_11_24) and the three borrow scripts of cycles/032/established-l1.work/borrow.py (getFeeGrowthInside below range, above range and in-range wrap), each run on one endpoint at a time through run_url.py with PM_FROM set to the chain, bracketed by web3_clientVersion and arc_getVersion before and after each set (scripts/pinned.py). 14 endpoints.
cleared.result: pmdiff: 250 of 250 scripts identical to Ethereum on all 14. pmdiff2: 300 of 300 on all Arc, MegaETH and BNB Chain endpoints, 299 of 300 on Elysium (Kinetiq, Conduit) and HyperEVM (official, nanoreth), where the one script is number 189, the same script that OPCODES.md (Check 2) records on these two networks as a swap with an open price limit that runs out of the endpoint's gas grant (opcodes/pmdiff2-gas.json). Borrow scripts: 42 of 42 equal the reference words. On Arc each set was bracketed by the same commit (37812c61, 8e8edb7a, 602eed3b, db2d22c1), so arithmetic and rollback results come from the same named build. On MegaETH official and both Elysium hosts and HyperEVM the brackets agree; on BNB Chain dataseed the brackets show both 'v1.8.2-4e1c8247' and a commit-less 'v1.8.2', and on 48 Club both 9b93ce23 and 132104cd, so those sets are pinned to a pair of builds, not one.

cleared.check: Whether this theme applies to the other 16 networks.
cleared.result: It does not. The theme covers builds that answer with no published source or binary. For these networks earlier cycles read the shipped binary or the published source of the client that answers (OPCODES.md, cycles 27 to 31), and their rollback was tested in cycles 16, 28 and 31.

cleared.check: Task 4: any answer that differs from pyevm.py, the specification rule or Ethereum.
cleared.result: None. Total compared answers: 655 nested cases, 48 unlock variants, 39 token probe runs plus 120 pinned Arc runs, 10 transaction reset checks, 3,500 pmdiff scripts, 4,200 pmdiff2 scripts (4,196 identical) and 42 borrow scripts; the only non-identical results are the four runs of pmdiff2 script 189 explained by gas. No take survives a reverted callback, no delta survives a revert, and no settle can read a balance a revert undid on any build that answered. Builds named by an endpoint that never answered a given probe: none for the state and rollback probes; Arc 37812c61, Arc db2d22c1, MegaETH v2.3.1-4499c42 and the official HyperEVM build never answered a log check or a transaction reset check, because they refuse eth_simulateV1 and debug_traceCall. dRPC returned HTTP 429 on five requests on HyperEVM and MegaETH, and on bsc.drpc.org at once; those were not retried around.

leads.question: Which source does Arc build db2d22c1 (v0.8.5 behind rpc.blockdaemon.mainnet.arc.io) come from, and does it differ from 602eed3b in the native value hook?
leads.why: It is a fourth Arc build, its commit is not in circlefin/arc-node, and the log drop of failed frames could not be checked on it because the host filters eth_simulateV1 and debug_traceCall.

leadResults.answer: On rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz and rpc-elysium-mainnet.t.conduit.xyz, both answering nitro/vlocal+unknown-unknown/linux-amd64/go1.25.12 before and after every batch, the Nitro live probe (settled, kept and nested) returns the pyevm.py bytes, TokenRollbackProbe with native HYPE leaves all balances unchanged in failed and static frames, 60 nested TSTORE and SSTORE cases equal the reference, transient storage is cleared between simulated transactions, and pmdiff, pmdiff2 and the borrow scripts match Ethereum except pmdiff2 script 189, which runs out of the endpoint's gas as recorded since cycle 9.

Each of the three named Arc builds and a fourth one (db2d22c1 on Blockdaemon) was pinned per request with arc_getVersion before and after: 37812c61 answered 40 runs, 8e8edb7a 40, 602eed3b 20 and db2d22c1 20. A native USDC transfer and a face transfer from the PoolManager inside reverted, invalid-halted, recursion-halted, out-of-gas and static frames left both faces of both accounts unchanged, and the control moved exactly one unit. Transfer logs from failed frames are dropped on 8e8edb7a and 602eed3b; 37812c61 and db2d22c1 serve no method that returns logs of a call.
